changes: Added docs/requirements/decisions/resolve-gap-analyze-three-high-gaps-execution-plan.md and updated docs/requirements/NAV.md to include the new execution plan with the correct 47-file count.

expectedOutcome: The user can open the new plan and see how to clear the current three high gaps without creating new current uncovered requirements or false capability claims.

outcomeDiff: Actual matched expected for this docs-only planning story. The three high gaps remain open intentionally; this story writes the execution path, not the implementation fix.
